feed.title: Scarface decomp: new matches
feed.subtitle: Functions of Scarface: The World Is Yours rebuilt in C++ that compiles to the exact same bytes.

entry.title: sub_002CE3C0 (Xbox, 80 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Makes a string from a piece of text; with no text it shares the one empty string (counting one more user). 0x002CE3C0 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00240820 (Xbox, 73 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Leaves the current entry: moves the stream on past whatever is left of it, then drops back to the entry before. 0x00240820 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00240630 (Xbox, 59 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Says whether the stream's current position is still inside the current entry's range (only when that entry has data). 0x00240630 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00166CE0 (Xbox, 65 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Returns the object it keeps a handle to; failing that, asks its member at +0x2AC for one and uses it if that one agrees. 0x00166CE0 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_002CE560 (Xbox, 75 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Releases a string's text: one fewer user, and when it was the last, gives its memory back (never the shared empty one). 0x002CE560 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00073400 (Xbox, 85 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
